reason: $29.99 for a month of magnesium is more than Toplux or Goli, and I already have a drawer of half-used bottles. The lab report and empty-box guarantee are nice, but I would wait for a bigger coupon.
objection: I pay about $0.83 a day only if I buy two boxes, and I do not want to commit $50 to a brand I have never tried when cheaper options last longer.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $19.99 a box, or a first-box deal under $15 with the same guarantee.
